raw: {"analysis":"XFJ provides a more concrete and actionable plan, specifying exact polling intervals, hard time caps, and a clear serialization point where Lane C defines the endpoint URL and ignore-list syntax before Lanes A and B can integrate. DZZ covers similar constraints but is more process-heavy and less specific about implementation details, such as the exact polling strategy and how the warm-up endpoint is designated as the sole authority.
